name: fairwork-monorepo
description: FairWork: Blockchain Freelance Agreement Platform with Milestone Escrow & AI GitHub Verification

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix "PERSON1 YASH NAIK/contracts" install && npm --prefix "PERSON2 DHRUV/backend" install && npm --prefix "PERSON4 SUZAN" install && echo "Node dependencies installed."
scripts.deploy: npx --prefix "PERSON1 YASH NAIK/contracts" hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network localhost
scripts.seed: npx --prefix "PERSON1 YASH NAIK/contracts" hardhat run scripts/seed.js --network localhost
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "CHAIN,AI,API,WEB" -c "yellow,magenta,blue,green" "npm run chain" "npm run ai" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:backend && npm run test:ai && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:seams
